method: For each candidate family, call the ACTUAL product consumer API (capsuleForConsumer) and classify the result; a manually constructed Capsule is never sufficient.

familyA.evidence: utility-candidate-fixtures.json: capsuleForConsumer returned AUTHORIZED with a bounded Capsule (coverage PARTIAL, 3 of 8 events), and both CONTROL and TREATMENT inputs were produced by the real product renderer.

familyB.evidence: test/trajectory_p2d1_capsule_admission.test.ts test 17 and test/trajectory_p2d1_source_contract.test.ts F5: an Attempt with one qualified invocation beside an unresolved one yields AMBIGUOUS_REQUIRES_SELECTION and capsuleForConsumer refuses with ORIGIN_NOT_SELECTED.
familyB.whyIntentionallyFailClosed: §10.1: the strict selection rule is a SAFETY property and must not be weakened merely to make a benchmark run.

options.A_keepStrictRefusal: a benchmark about RECOGNISING the ambiguity is possible but does not expose the qualified page as trusted evidence
options.B_trustedPreselectedInvocation: a trusted Context/Experiment Owner could select one already-qualified invocation before the model turn; the existing requestedInvocationId selector is the mechanism. NOT implemented in E0.
options.C_defer: chosen: Family B is reported NOT_DELIVERABLE as a MULTI-INVOCATION benchmark in this stage
